integrity: The defining set and trace evaluation are independently reconstructed over \(\mathbb F_8\). The length, dimension, and published ordinary enumerator are reproduced before higher-support calculations are accepted. All \(2824\) positive-dimensional message subspaces are then enumerated exactly once in reduced-row-echelon form.
scientific_limitations: The result is an exact finite higher-support census for the \(m=3\), \(d=1\) member of the trace-defined family. It does not give an all-parameter formula and does not classify subcodes up to automorphism.
title: Complete higher-support profile of a projective minimal binary \([24,6,10]\) trace code
